name: type:feat
description: New behavior, capability, surface area, or supported workflow

name: type:fix
description: Broken, incorrect, confusing, or regressed behavior

name: type:nit
description: Small polish, copy, cleanup, tiny UX adjustment, or low-risk refinement

name: priority:high
description: Important soon, blocks other work, or meaningfully affects core UX

name: priority:medium
description: Valuable, but not urgent or blocking

name: status:unknown
description: Needs clarification, research, scoping, or acceptance criteria

name: status:ready
description: Clear enough to implement without unresolved product decisions

name: status:blocked
description: Cannot proceed until a decision or dependency is resolved

name: status:duplicate
description: Tracks the same outcome as another issue
